Runtime JSON (core/kg-hub/contracts): read by BizCity_Journal_Job_Link; docs/ is never read at runtime.
rule: docs/rules/PHASE-0-RULE-BRAIN-SKELETON.md (BS-5 header row rule, BS-6 join keys)

job_id.note: the cell's id (machine). Site resolves job_id → job_ref.

job_ref.note: the header row's code (human; R-JN-25) = JB-<entry_id of the job.run row>

role.note: which box the Job screen draws this row in

step_ref.note: plan@1.steps[].id this row belongs to; null = the whole job

version_ref.note: the exact version used: TL-47@v2 (file-version@1) · SO-cash@s3 (sheet schema)

shape.ref: hash or principal ref, never a raw uid / phone

parent_job_ref.note: a sub-job delegated to another assistant / number (Zalo Brain → Zalo Brain)

conversation_ref.note: the chat thread to report progress back to

on_the_row_itself.source_ref: column source_ref — where this row came from (TL-47, msg:…, another row's code)
on_the_row_itself.derived_from: metadata.derived_from — entry ids used as input (R-JN-10)
on_the_row_itself.output_refs: HEADER ONLY (card.output_refs on the job.run row) — codes of the products; the site appends when a child row with role output is written

query.note: the site stamps the tag on every row of the job (tags column, LIKE index — same trick as grp-<gid>); journal.find{job: JB-31} = every row of the job, no JSON scan, no new column

header_row.when: steps >= 2 OR writes >= 1 journal row OR approval / schedule / automation / delivery to another person (Q126-17, BS-5). A one-turn answer never opens one.
header_row.title: plan.goal (or 'Việc <id>' until the goal is known)

status.note: never verified — verified is a person's act (R-JN-14)

header_row.writer: site: BizCity_Journal_Job_Link::on_job_event (job-event@1.1 via bizcity_twin_job_event) and ::attach (journal.record with job)

not_here: step rows (the machine ledger stays in the cell assistant_jobs + the event stream, R-JN-19); no second job table (R-LEAN-4)
